title: Prediction markets are expanding into mainstream media, with integrations in Dow Jones, Substack, CNN, CNBC, and more, as they become an informational channel (Kate Knibbs/Wired)
summary: Kate Knibbs / Wired: Prediction markets are expanding into mainstream media, with integrations in Dow Jones, Substack, CNN, CNBC, and more, as they become an informational channel — The legal battle over whether prediction markets are a form of gambling has overshadowed something else entirely: They're already a new form of media.
